title: Win Back Quiet Sales Leads
summary: Find the leads and threads that stopped replying, and get a follow-up drafted for each one you choose to send.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you have sales threads that go quiet; the value is fewer open loops left unanswered.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Leads you already have get a second chance.
Open loops get closed instead of forgotten.
who_its_for: Sales and account owners with a busy inbox.

steps: Set the quiet period for your sales threads.
Review the list of quiet leads.
Say go only on the drafts you want sent.
guardrails: Nothing is sent until you read the draft and say go.
Give the bots only the mailboxes you want them to read.
